## Submission Preference

**How would you like to contribute this use case?**

- [ ] **Full documentation**: I'll fill out the complete [use case template](../../use-cases/TEMPLATE-use-case-description.md) and submit via pull request
- [ ] **Assisted documentation**: I'll provide information via this issue, and working group can help draft the full use case
- [ ] **Interview/Discussion**: I'd prefer to discuss verbally and have working group document
- [ ] **Anonymous submission**: Contact working group chair privately
